description: This file defines the ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams class, which extends FilterParams and specifies filter parameters for actionable review searches within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It includes constants for inclusion options, properties to store filter criteria such as employee numbers and statuses, and getter/setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: ActionableReviewSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object class used to encapsulate filter parameters for querying actionable reviews, including employee identifiers and statuses.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: getReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the reviewer employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewerEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the reviewer employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: getIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the include employees filter option.

methods.name: setIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Sets the include employees filter option.

methods.name: getActionableStatuses
methods.description: Returns the list of actionable statuses used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setActionableStatuses
methods.description: Sets the list of actionable statuses used as filter criteria.

methods.name: getSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Returns the self-review statuses used as filter criteria.

methods.name: setSelfReviewStatuses
methods.description: Sets the self-review statuses used as filter criteria.
